title: EXP-008 — Form Description Persistence Across Close-Only Reopen
objective: Create one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form, FX_FormPropertyLab07, using the verified basic-form recipe; record its untouched Form-property baseline; change only its Form-level Description to the literal value `Form Property Description Close Only`; ordinary-save to a demonstrably clean Designer state; close the target Form; do not invoke Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects; reopen the exact same customized Form version identified by Form name + ScopeType + ScopeName; and verify that Description plus all recorded comparison properties are recovered unchanged. Also record, as diagnostic evidence only, whether any ClearCache-style request is observed around the close/reopen sequence, without inferring IDO-metadata or system-wide cache semantics.

Perform a final read-only audit proving exactly one `FX_FormPropertyLab07` exists, the persisted AC-8 values are still present, the User Preference was not changed, no explicit global-Form-object unload occurred, and experiment-attributable repository changes are confined to the EXP-008 record plus `evidence/EXP-008/`.

Classify the result no higher than `observed`: if AC-1 through AC-9 pass, record only that literal User-scope Description recovery across this specific ordinary close/reopen path was observed once. notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261002-135829-sjDK. Rationale: EXP-007 + EXP-007-R2 replay-verified literal User-scope Form Description recovery across the Save → close → explicit Unload All Global Form Objects → reopen workflow. The smallest independent next question is whether the same Description survives an ordinary close/reopen when no explicit global-Form-object unload is invoked. This builds directly on a verified property/edit path, avoids the blocked variable topic, and narrows one open boundary question without attempting to infer IDO-cache internals. The experiment will keep the current User scope and require the existing Unload IDO Metadata With Forms preference to remain unchanged. Any captured ClearCache/network activity is diagnostic only and must not be interpreted as proving IDO or complete cache semantics.
